headlines.title: Union Pacific's bid to control 40% of U.S. rail track could raise prices on everyday goods, union warns
headlines.summary: The deal could be bad both for railroad workers and the economy that relies on railroads for cheap shipping.

headlines.title: Union Pacific Has Raised Its Dividend for 20 Years. These 3 Railroads Offer Income
headlines.summary: Three railroads sit on networks no rival could ever rebuild, yet their yields look thin and one dividend has not budged in years. A pending merger and a regulator's pending ruling could decide which payout deserves a spot in your income plan.

headlines.title: What Does Union Pacific (UNP) Owe After The Teamsters Arbitration Ruling?
headlines.summary: Union Pacific (NYSE:UNP) has been ordered to pay a multimillion dollar arbitration award to the BLET Teamsters union. The ruling centers on Union Pacific’s failure to implement a negotiated work schedule benefit for locomotive engineers. Arbitrators directed the railroad to compensate affected workers after confirming the schedule benefit had not been put in place as agreed.

headlines.title: BLET TEAMSTERS WIN HISTORIC MULTIMILLION-DOLLAR ARBITRATION AWARD AGAINST UNION PACIFIC
headlines.summary: The Brotherhood of Locomotive Engineers and Trainmen (BLET) of the Teamsters Rail Conference has won an historic arbitration award against Union Pacific Railroad (UP), securing an estimated $98.8 million in compensation for members who filed claims in response to the carrier failing to implement a negotiated benefit.

headlines.title: Trump Officials Met Privately With Hedge Funds on Mega Rail Deal
headlines.summary: In a highly unusual gathering, White House officials met privately this week with a group of hedge fund investors betting on whether the $72 billion tie-up between Union Pacific Corp. and Norfolk Southern Corp. will win approval from the Trump administration, according to people familiar with the matter.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
